test_type: CR-035: Store Creation 2-Step Flow + Outlet Visibility
summary: CR-035 implementation verified. Part A (2-step wizard) and Part B (outlet visibility) both working correctly. Fixed a bug where catalog counts showed 0 due to key mismatch and type checking issue.

features_tested.feature: Part A Q1: Create Store button opens Step 1 with 6 fields + step indicator
features_tested.details: Step 1 shows Store Name, Store Type, Email, Phone, Password, Address fields. Step indicator shows '1 Store Details' and '2 Review & Push'.

features_tested.feature: Part A Q2: Next without required fields shows toast error
features_tested.details: Toast error 'Please fill all required fields' appears, form stays on Step 1.

features_tested.feature: Part A Q3: Fill required fields, click Next shows Step 2 with summary + catalog counts
features_tested.details: Step 2 shows summary banner ('Creating: Test Store ABC as Master Store') and 7 catalog count cards (Categories: 2, Ingredients: 49, Products: 2, Recipes: 2, Sub-Recipes: 5, Addons: 0, Roles: 13).

features_tested.feature: Part A Q4: Back button returns to Step 1 with fields preserved
features_tested.details: After clicking Back, Step 1 shows with Store Name and Email values preserved.

features_tested.feature: Part A Q6: Cancel closes the form on Step 1
features_tested.details: Cancel button closes the create store form.

features_tested.feature: Part B Q7: All tab shows correct total count
features_tested.details: All tab shows 'All (6)' - more than just 2 direct children, confirming outlets are merged.

features_tested.feature: Part B Q8: Outlet filter shows outlets with nested indicator
features_tested.details: Outlet tab shows 'Outlet (3)' with 3 outlets. Alpha Outlet One shows with nested indicator (↳).

features_tested.feature: Part B Q9: Master filter shows Master stores
features_tested.details: Master tab shows 'Master (3)' - test 1, Central Kitchen Beta, Central Kitchen Alpha.

bugs_fixed.issue: Catalog count cards showing 0 for all categories in Step 2
bugs_fixed.root_cause: 1) Key mismatch: code used 'stock_item_categories', 'inventory_items', 'addon_recipes' but API returns 'categories', 'ingredients', 'addons', etc. 2) Type mismatch: code expected arrays but API returns numbers.
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated keys to match API response (categories, ingredients, foods, recipes, sub_recipes, addons, roles) and added type check: typeof entities[key] === 'number' ? entities[key] : (Array.isArray(entities[key]) ? entities[key].length : 0)

context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-035 2-step wizard and outlet visibility verified. Fixed catalog count display bug in StoreManagement.jsx. The displayChildren memo correctly merges outlets from allStores (fetched via hierarchy-detail API). Filter pills (All/Master/Outlet) work correctly. Nested outlet indicator (↳) displays for outlets that are children of Master stores.
